headline: South Korean Entertainment Stocks Surge up to 30% Following China Trade Deal
summary: Shares of South Korean entertainment companies jumped by as much as 30% following the announcement of a new trade agreement with China.
why: South Korean entertainment firms rely heavily on exports to major Asian markets, including China.

impacts.name: South Korean Entertainment Sector
impacts.why: News of a trade agreement with China sparked sharp gains across South Korean media and entertainment shares.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors reacted positively to reduced trade barriers opening expanded content distribution in China.
